title: Technical
subTitle: As a full stack engineer, I build scalable systems end-to-end — from frontend interfaces to backend microservices and cloud infrastructure — using a diverse and evolving set of tools and technologies.

polymath.title: Full stack foundations
polymath.copy: With a strong foundation across frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure, I bring a holistic perspective to every project. I am constantly learning and adapting — whether it's picking up a new framework for a modernization effort or diving into cloud-native patterns for enterprise-scale deployments.

software.title: Software I love to work with
software.copy: I leverage a carefully curated set of tools to maximize productivity and collaboration. From design and API testing to database management and architectural planning, these are the tools that power my daily workflow.

tech.title: Technologies I love to build with
tech.copy: I deeply enjoy solving problems through code — from frontend interfaces to backend services, cloud infrastructure, and everything in between. These are the core technologies I work with across my projects.
